title: Late check-in in Edinburgh
tagline: It's 11 pm, the room you booked is not the room you got, and you have a meeting at 8.
setting: A mid-range hotel on Princes Street, Edinburgh, 11 pm on a rainy Sunday. The lobby is quiet. The bar closed at 10:30. There is a 24-hour reception.
playerRole: You booked a double room with a desk for two nights under your surname. You arrive late, tired, and want to check in, get the Wi-Fi password and ask for an early breakfast because of an 8 am meeting.

npcs.name: Callum
npcs.personality: Soft Scottish accent, laid-back, apologetic when something goes wrong, genuinely wants to help. Will offer alternatives rather than say no.
knowledge: The booking exists but the system shows a twin room, not a double. Double rooms with a desk are available on the 4th floor for the same price if the player asks.
Wi-Fi network is 'PrincesGuest', password is the room number followed by 'edin' (e.g. 412edin).
Breakfast is 7:00 to 10:00 in the basement restaurant. An early continental tray can be left at reception from 6:30 if requested the night before.
Checkout is 11:00. Late checkout until 13:00 costs £20.
The bar is closed; there is a vending machine on floor 2 and a 24-hour shop two doors down.
He needs a passport or ID and a card for incidentals.
npcs.greeting: Evening! Awful weather out there. Checking in?

npcs.name: Tomasz
npcs.personality: Polish software developer in town for the same conference, friendly, direct, slightly jet-lagged. Likes to compare notes about cities and work.
knowledge: The conference venue (EICC) is a 15-minute walk from the hotel, or a 5-minute taxi.
Taxis take 10 to 20 minutes to arrive at this hour; black cabs are faster from the rank at Waverley station.
The hotel's breakfast is decent but slow; the cafe across the road opens at 6:30.
He stayed on the 4th floor last year and the rooms with desks face the castle.
npcs.greeting: You look as tired as I feel. Long trip?

objectives.title: Check in and get the room you booked
objectives.hint: Give Callum your name, notice the room type is wrong and politely get it fixed. Get the Wi-Fi password.
objectives.successCriteria: The player has checked in, has raised the twin/double problem and accepted a solution, and has the Wi-Fi password.

objectives.title: Arrange an early breakfast
objectives.hint: Explain you have an 8 am meeting and ask what the options are for eating before 7.
objectives.successCriteria: The player has asked about early breakfast and Callum has arranged a 6:30 tray or the player has accepted another option.

objectives.title: Find out how to get to the venue tomorrow
objectives.hint: Make small talk with Tomasz and find out how long it takes to get to the conference centre.
objectives.successCriteria: The player knows the venue is a 15-minute walk or a short taxi, and has exchanged at least two turns of small talk.
